mapper.sql: SELECT c.*,o.display_name AS organization_name,hb.booking_code,ao.order_code,(SELECT m.content FROM marketplace_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id=c.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.sequence_no DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_content
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketplace_conversation_members(conversation_id,user_id,member_role,joined_at) VALUES(#{conversationId},#{userId},#{role},#{joinedAt}) ON CONFLICT(conversation_id,user_id) DO UPDATE SET left_at=NULL,member_role=EXCLUDED.member_role
mapper.select: ,0::bigint AS unread_count FROM marketplace_conversations c LEFT JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=c.organization_id LEFT JOIN hotel_bookings hb ON hb.id=c.hotel_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_orders ao ON ao.id=c.activity_order_id WHERE c.id=#{id}

,0::bigint AS unread_count FROM marketplace_conversations c LEFT JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=c.organization_id LEFT JOIN hotel_bookings hb ON hb.id=c.hotel_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_orders ao ON ao.id=c.activity_order_id WHERE c.hotel_booking_id=#{id}

,0::bigint AS unread_count FROM marketplace_conversations c LEFT JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=c.organization_id LEFT JOIN hotel_bookings hb ON hb.id=c.hotel_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_orders ao ON ao.id=c.activity_order_id WHERE c.activity_order_id=#{id}

,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketplace_messages um LEFT JOIN marketplace_messages rm ON rm.id=cm.last_read_message_id WHERE um.conversation_id=c.id AND um.sequence_no>COALESCE(rm.sequence_no,0) AND um.sender_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{userId}) AS unread_count FROM marketplace_conversations c JOIN marketplace_conversation_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=#{userId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=c.organization_id LEFT JOIN hotel_bookings hb ON hb.id=c.hotel_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_orders ao ON ao.id=c.activity_order_id ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST,c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marketplace_messages um LEFT JOIN marketplace_messages rm ON rm.id=cm.last_read_message_id WHERE um.conversation_id=c.id AND um.sequence_no>COALESCE(rm.sequence_no,0) AND um.sender_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{viewerId}) AS unread_count FROM marketplace_conversations c LEFT JOIN marketplace_conversation_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=#{viewerId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=c.organization_id LEFT JOIN hotel_bookings hb ON hb.id=c.hotel_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_orders ao ON ao.id=c.activity_order_id WHERE c.organization_id=#{organizationId} AND c.status=#{status} ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST,c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

,0::bigint AS unread_count FROM marketplace_conversations c LEFT JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=c.organization_id LEFT JOIN hotel_bookings hb ON hb.id=c.hotel_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_orders ao ON ao.id=c.activity_order_id AND c.status=#{status} AND (o.display_name ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR hb.booking_code ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%') OR ao.order_code ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{query},'%')) ORDER BY c.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST,c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marketplace_conversations c LEFT JOIN marketplace_conversation_members cm ON cm.conversation_id=c.id AND cm.user_id=#{userId} AND cm.left_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN host_organizations o ON o.id=c.organization_id LEFT JOIN organization_members om ON om.organization_id=c.organization_id AND om.user_id=#{userId} AND om.member_status='ACTIVE' AND (om.valid_from IS NULL OR om.valid_from<=NOW()) AND (om.valid_until IS NULL OR om.valid_until>NOW()) WHERE c.id=#{conversationId} AND (cm.user_id IS NOT NULL OR o.owner_user_id=#{userId} OR om.user_id IS NOT NULL))
SELECT id FROM marketplace_conversations WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no),0)+1 FROM marketplace_messages WHERE conversation_id=#{id}

SELECT m.*,u.full_name AS sender_name,u.avatar_url AS sender_avatar_url FROM marketplace_messages m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=m.sender_user_id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.sender_user_id=#{senderId} AND m.client_message_id=#{clientId}
SELECT m.*,u.full_name AS sender_name,u.avatar_url AS sender_avatar_url FROM marketplace_messages m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=m.sender_user_id WHERE m.id=#{id}

SELECT m.*,u.full_name AS sender_name,u.avatar_url AS sender_avatar_url FROM marketplace_messages m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id=m.sender_user_id WHERE m.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND m.sequence_no>#{afterSequence} ORDER BY m.sequence_no LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketplace_conversations SET last_message_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE marketplace_conversation_members SET last_read_message_id=#{messageId} WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marketplace_messages WHERE id=#{messageId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId})
UPDATE marketplace_messages SET deleted_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{messageId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
